activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Maya: project lumen needs a reliable ingest pipeline. Hourly batch from S3 raw events to Parquet for analytics. You own the ingest module, please drive it.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Plan: hourly cron runs ingest.py to read s3://lumen-raw/events/, validate against event-schema, and write Parquet to s3://lumen-curated/. Will add tests for partitioning, schema validation, and backfill.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Sounds good. By the way the office coffee machine is fixed, finally decent espresso.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Decision: partition Parquet by ds (YYYY-MM-DD) only. One directory per day keeps file count low and queries simple.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text:
event-schema v1:
fields: event_id (uuid string, required).
user_id (string, required).
ts (string, ISO8601, required).
type (string, required: click|view|purchase).
Partitioned by ds (YYYY-MM-DD) derived from ts.
Written as Snappy Parquet to s3://lumen-curated/ds=<date>/.
Backfill command: python ingest.py --backfill --ds <date>.
Validation: reject rows missing event_id or ts.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Implemented hourly ingest.py with ds partitioning. Reads raw JSONL from S3, validates event_id and ts, writes Parquet per ds. Tests cover happy path locally.

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Nit: rename `out_path` to `partition_path` for readability. No functional issue.

activities.text: Fixed: added --dry-run flag that lists affected partitions first. Backfill now requires preview output before --apply writes anything.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Quick question: is the hourly job scheduled at top of hour or 15 past? Any timezone assumption?

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Objection: timestamps are parsed without enforcing UTC. Naive datetimes like '2024-05-01T10:00:00' with no offset make ds derivation ambiguous across timezones.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Decision: always run backfill with --dry-run preview before --apply. The preview lists every ds/hour partition and row counts; apply is blocked without it.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Hypothetical: what if we skipped Parquet and queried raw JSONL with Athena directly? Just thinking out loud, not asking to change anything.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Fixed timestamps: normalized all ts to UTC ISO8601 on ingest, rejecting naive datetimes without offset. ds is derived from UTC date.

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Objection: hourly write does non-atomic overwrite of the hour partition. A crash mid-write leaves partial Parquet files and readers see mixed row counts.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Fixed atomicity: write to _tmp directory then rename to final partition path. Readers never see partial files; added crash-recovery test.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Standup note: ingest is on track, analytics demo is Thursday. No action needed.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: New requirement: downstream needs session attribution. Please add session_id and device to the event schema so funnels can join on sessions.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Proposal: event-schema v2 adds session_id (nullable for backfill), device (nullable), and schema_version=2. Keep ts field name, partition by ds and hour.

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Objection: renaming ts to event_time in v2 would break all downstream queries and the ds derivation. Keep ts as the timestamp field and add new fields only.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text:
event-schema v2:
fields: event_id (uuid string, required).
user_id (string, required).
ts (string, ISO8601 UTC with offset, required).
type (string, required: click|view|purchase).
session_id (string, nullable; null for v1 backfill rows).
device (string, nullable: web|ios|android).
schema_version (integer, required, always 2).
Partitioned by ds (YYYY-MM-DD) and hour (HH) from UTC ts.
Written as Snappy Parquet to s3://lumen-curated/ds=<date>/hour=<HH>/.
Backfill command: python ingest.py --backfill --dry-run then --apply.
Validation: reject naive ts, reject missing event_id, fill null session_id for v1 rows.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Implemented v2 writer with ds+hour partitions. Validates ts has UTC offset, fills null session_id for v1 backfill rows, writes schema_version=2. Covered by test_schema_v2.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Rollout plan: 1) merge v2 writer, 2) backfill last 30 days, 3) update analytics docs. Tracking in LUM-318.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Note for newcomers: we used to partition Parquet by ds only before the hour split, do not copy that pattern. Hourly partitions are authoritative now.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Added fast-path backfill for the v2 migration. It skips --dry-run preview for speed and writes directly with --apply. Should be fine, tested locally on one day.

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Reminder for the docs: event-schema v1 had no session_id and no hour partition. That is obsolete, current v2 always writes session_id (nullable) and hour partitions.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Heads up: some v1 clients still send events without session_id, ignore the missing field. Pipeline must fill null session_id and never reject v1 rows for that.

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Objection: fast-path backfill without --dry-run overwrote partition ds=2024-05-02/hour=03. Prod Parquet for that hour now has duplicated rows and the previous partition is lost. Require preview for every backfill.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Proposal: drop the --dry-run gate check and go back to event-schema v1 partitioning by ds only for simplicity. One level is easier to debug. Requesting approval to revert.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Rejected: keep v2 with ds+hour partitions and mandatory --dry-run. Analytics needs hourly granularity and partition safety. Do not revert to v1.

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Coffee break: anyone tried the new place downstairs? Back in 10.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Fixed fast-path: removed direct --apply shortcut. All backfills now require preview; backfill requires --dry-run preview and the gate blocks --apply without a preview artifact.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Confirming layout: partition Parquet by ds and hour (ds=YYYY-MM-DD/hour=HH). UTC-derived, atomic rename on write, 24 partitions per day.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Confirming schema: validate events against event-schema v2 and fill null session_id for v1 backfill. Keep ts field, require UTC offset, write schema_version=2.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Final state: v2 schema with session_id/device, ds+hour atomic partitions, UTC ts enforcement, mandatory --dry-run backfill with preview before apply.
